list_drafts (security_advisories.py:136-143) rejects any next link whose path != ADVISORIES (/repos/The01Geek/sqllens/security-advisories, line 20). Link is parsed at line 67 and used verbatim. First half holds: build_opener(NoRedirect()) replaces the default HTTPRedirectHandler with the subclass, and redirect_request (security_advisories.py:33-36) raises AuditError before any redirect is followed. Second half is false: the clause at line 69 catches only HTTPError, URLError, OSError, ValueError. AuditError subclasses Exception (line 28), so the AuditError raised at line 66 and from NoRedirect is not caught by it; it propagates as itself, not wrapped. Also http.client.HTTPException subclasses such as IncompleteRead or BadStatusLine, which response.read or the opener can raise, are not OSError or ValueError and escape uncaught as raw exceptions, bypassing the fixed 'GitHub request failed' message that the module says must keep details out of public logs. No rejection line covers this.
